{{Top|leg}}
'''Wi'looa''' was a prominent [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] singer during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Her lounging slippers were once stolen and put on the black market, prompting a [[Unidentified colonel (Wi'looa)|prominent]] [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]] to try and acquire her footwear.<ref name="Closet">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=crewskill|Underworld Trading|Closet Collector}}</ref>
